name: mforge-mumps-vista-ide
description: A modern VS Code IDE toolkit for MUMPS, GT.M/YottaDB, and VistA development with highlighting, navigation, IntelliSense, diagnostics, formatting, semantic tokens, and routine indexing.

scripts.test: npm run test:semantic-contributions && npm run test:stage2 && npm run test:stage3 && npm run test:stage4 && npm run test:stage45 && npm run test:stage46 && npm run test:stage5
scripts.package: npm run env:check && npm run compile && npm run test && vsce package

commands.title: MForge: Debug References In Current Line
MForge: Save Detected Routine Paths To Settings

mforge.trace.level.description: Controls diagnostic logging for MForge extension features.

mforge.formatter.enabled.description: Enable the conservative MForge document formatter for MUMPS files.

mforge.diagnostics.enabled.description: Enable basic MForge diagnostics for MUMPS files.

mforge.navigation.enabled.description: Enable MUMPS navigation features: document links, Ctrl+Click, definitions, routine indexing, document symbols, and workspace symbols.

mforge.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: Maximum number of supported MUMPS routine files to scan lazily for the workspace routine index.

mforge.hover.enabled.description: Enable Stage 4 MUMPS hover help for commands, intrinsic functions, and system variables.

mforge.completion.enabled.description: Enable Stage 4 MUMPS completion for commands, intrinsics, system variables, labels, and routines.

mforge.signatureHelp.enabled.description: Enable Stage 4 MUMPS intrinsic function signature help.

mforge.semanticHighlighting.enabled.description: Enable Stage 4.5 semantic highlighting for MUMPS files.

mforge.workspaceScanDebounceMs.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds before marking the MUMPS workspace routine index dirty after file events.

mforge.routineSearchPaths.description: Additional absolute or workspace-relative folders to scan for MUMPS routine files outside the active workspace root.

mforge.indexExtensionlessRoutines.description: Index extensionless routine files in workspace and mforge.routineSearchPaths. Enable for VistA/YottaDB exports that omit file extensions.

mforge.autoDetectRoutinePaths.description: Automatically detects common VistA/YottaDB routine folders and adds them to the routine index without modifying user settings.

mforge.autoRebuildIndexOnActivation.description: Automatically rebuilds the MUMPS routine index shortly after activation when routine folders are detected.

mforge.references.enabled.description: Enable Stage 5.1 Find References for local labels, cross-routine LABEL^ROUTINE calls, and same-document local variables.

mforge.references.includeDeclarations.description: Include label declarations or routine-top fallback locations in MForge Find References results when VS Code requests declarations.

mforge.references.maxResults.description: Maximum number of locations returned by MForge Find References before truncating results.

semanticTokenTypes.description: Common FileMan and VistA-style API entry points.
MUMPS routine references that are likely navigable.
MUMPS routine references whose target routine is not currently indexed.
